title: NFT Use Cases, Today and Tomorrow

reader_summary.headline: Welcome to the A16Z podcast, um, Zorin.
reader_summary.overview: Welcome to the A16Z podcast, um, Zorin. Recently, A16Z and the Stanford Center for Blockchain Research hosted the NFT Virtual Summit. We've covered NFTs in other podcasts and articles, including a curated list of reading resources, available at A16Z.com slash NFTs.

key_points.text: Recently, A16Z and the Stanford Center for Blockchain Research hosted the NFT Virtual Summit.
key_points.evidence_quote: Recently, A16Z and the Stanford Center for Blockchain Research hosted the NFT Virtual Summit, which brought together leading thinkers and builders on the topic of NFTs or non-fungeable tokens, which are enabling new creator and ownership economies to emerge.

key_points.text: Today we're sharing one of the discussions from the virtual summit, all of which were published on our A16Z live.
key_points.evidence_quote: Today we're sharing one of the discussions from the virtual summit, all of which were published on our A16Z live.

key_points.text: This episode features General Partner Katie Hahn, chatting with Devin Finzer, co-founder of NFT Marketplace OpenC.
key_points.evidence_quote: This episode features General Partner Katie Hahn, chatting with Devin Finzer, co-founder of NFT Marketplace OpenC, on the topic of NFT use cases today and tomorrow.

key_points.text: They cover, quote, the tokenization of everything.
key_points.evidence_quote: They cover, quote, the tokenization of everything.
